OpenGWASDB Reference-Completed at full scale — OGS-00010

Imputing 10.7 billion associations into the 2,024-trait UK Biobank release · what it costs, and what it buys

Published

September 21, 2026

ImportantWhat this measures

OGS-00010 is OGS-00009 run through Reference Completion: the same 2,024 UK Biobank ukb-b Analyses, the same Dense Store format, and one LD Reference Panel used to impute the associations the source GWAS-VCFs never reported.

  • 10.67 billion associations imputed into the store — 38.9% of its 27.43 billion cells — in 8.8 h on 32 workers.
  • That is 336,563 imputed cells per second, every second, for nine hours.
  • 1,865,291 of the 6,333,255 genome-wide-significant hits in the collection (29.5%) exist only because completion ran. A PheWAS at the reference variant the OGS-00009 report timed now returns 2,020 of 2,024 Analyses where the observed-only release returned 1,088.
  • The store is 49.33 GB against 345.01 GB of source VCF (6.99x), and every imputed cell cost 1.37 bytes on top of the observed-only store.
  • Indexed queries still return in 1.3 ms; opening and querying costs ~201 MB of RAM.
  • Three end-to-end MR runs (BMI → CHD, an LDL proxy → CHD, smoking → lung cancer) each on all variants, observed-only, and imputed-only, and every observed cell of OGS-00009 decodes bit-identically inside OGS-00010.

What completion adds

The Dense axis is a grid: every variant against every Analysis. In the observed-only release a source GWAS-VCF reports what it reports, and everything else is NaN. Completion fills the grid wherever the LD panel can support it.

Cell state Cells Share of the axis
Observed (source-reported) 11,154,507,008 40.7%
Imputed from the LD panel 10,668,189,324 38.9%
On-panel, imputation rejected 190,176,174 0.7%
Off-panel (unimputable) 5,412,303,206 19.7%

The two panels say the same thing at two densities: imputed cells are 38.9% of the whole grid, and at the end source GWAS looked hardest — the genome-wide-significant tier, where MR, PheWAS and regional inspection actually live — they are still 29.5% of everything significant in the collection. Coverage is thinner exactly where truth is densest, but 1,865,291 significant hits are ones a per-file collection cannot answer at all.

The same variant queried identically against both releases:

Imputation performance

Measure Value
Completion wall clock 31,697 s (8.8 h), 32 workers
LD blocks processed 1,357 (23.4 s per block on average)
Imputed-cell throughput 336,563 cells/s (10,518 per worker)
Axis growth 9,847,701 -> 13,549,988 variants (+3,702,287 panel-only)
Observed store (OGS-00009) build 5.92 h
End-to-end pipeline (build + completion) 14.72 h for 27.43 billion cells

The completion is a block-parallel process pool over the panel’s LD blocks (ADR 0023): every worker elastic-net-regresses one Analysis’s observed z-scores onto the panel’s eigenvectors inside one block, polynomial-rescales the prediction onto the observed scale, and only keeps the imputed values if the rescaled prediction matches the block’s observed z with r ≥ 0.7. Failed blocks leave the cell NaN; they are never quietly substituted.

Of 2,746,568 Analysis x block rows, 18,749 never attempted imputation (too few observed points to fit) and 2,727,819 did. The gate rejects an attempt outright below r = 0.7 — 19,597 of 2,727,819 attempts (0.72%, the red bars) — so the tail the quality metric hides is small and shown. The median attempt reaches r = 0.973; even the first percentile (0.796) clears the gate, the fifth is 0.930 and the ninety-fifth 0.992. Every one of the 2,024 Analyses holds a median block r of at least 0.960 — the worst-imputed trait is still tracking its own observed signal at r > 0.96. This metric is in-sample (it measures the fit against the cells used to fit, not out-of-sample truth), and the MR section is where the predictions are checked against something that is not themselves.

Storage OGS-00009 observed OGS-00010 completed Completion added
Store size 34.68 GB 49.33 GB +14.65 GB
Cells on the axis 19,931,746,824 27,425,175,712 +7,493,428,888
Bytes per cell 1.740 B 1.799 B 1.37 B per imputed cell
Compression vs source VCF 9.95x 6.99x —

A float16 grid of the same shape would cost 55 GB before standard errors. The completed store carries imputed z, se, EAF and the provenance mask for 1.37 bytes per added cell because the residual codings of ADR 0037 compress the panel-derived values the same way they compress the observed ones — the format does not privilege imputed data with a special encoding, and does not tax it with a worse one.

Query performance

The shapes below are the same queries the OGS-00009 report timed — same driver Analysis, same PheWAS variant, same regional window, and the same randomly-selected variants and Analyses (re-derived from the source release’s recorded seed) — run against the completed axis.

Query OGS-00009 OGS-00010 Latency Results (09 -> 10)
Top hits for one Analysis (p < 5e-8) 1.15 ms 1.32 ms 1.15x 2,564 -> 3,488
PheWAS: one variant, all Analyses 6.48 ms 18.82 ms 2.90x 1,088 -> 2,020
Region restricted to one Analysis 24.11 ms 85.94 ms 3.56x 2,954 -> 4,645
Random lookup: 10 variants x 100 Analyses 70.72 ms 183.93 ms 2.60x 654 -> 868

  • Top hits, observed_only=True — new shape: 1.26 ms, 2,564 results
  • One Analysis genome-wide, observed_only=True — new shape: 47.32 s, 7,578,651 results

Read the latency column against the results column, because that is the whole story: shapes that returned the same data grow by the axis factor alone — top hits 1.15x (the observed_only=True twin runs within noise of OGS-00009, 1.26 ms vs 1.15 ms, at identical observed-cell result counts). The shapes that got more data pay for it almost exactly in proportion: the all-Analyses region grew 4.24M -> 8.73M results (2.29x latency), the PheWAS 1,088 -> 2,020 (2.90x), and one Analysis genome-wide 7.58M -> 11.23M results (1.63x). The imputed mask is a cheap parallel plane — but filtering to observed cells cannot make the wider axis shorter, which is what bulk_observed_only pays: 47.32 s where OGS-00009’s bulk took 30.04 s, returning the identical 7,578,651 cells. What the multiplier buys is completeness: the top-hits bar carries 924 genome-wide-significant hits that simply did not exist before.

Baseline stays at ~201 MB — the completed store opens like the observed one: nothing is loaded until asked for, and 27.4 billion cells cost nothing to have. Query cost still tracks result size, from a fraction of a megabyte for indexed shapes to 17.40 GB for reading a whole genome-wide Analysis.

Mendelian randomisation on three real pairs

Each pair is run three ways against the same store:

  • all — every instrument and every outcome cell the completed release offers,
  • observed — observed_only=True throughout: exactly what OGS-00009 could do,
  • imputed — instruments imputed in the exposure and imputed in the outcome: estimates that exist only because completion ran.

Instruments: p < 5e-8 in the exposure, greedy 1 Mb pruning, IVW ratio of per-instrument Wald ratios weighted by instrument precision. The store orientates every Analysis to the canonical ALID allele, so no harmonisation step is needed between exposure and outcome.

Pair Variants Instruments IVW beta se p
BMI -> CHD (I25.1) all 592 +0.0133 0.0009 1.1e-49
observed 591 +0.0132 0.0009 1.1e-48
imputed 487 +0.0125 0.0010 4e-36
LDL proxy (cholesterol-lowering medication) -> CHD (I25.1) all 35 +0.1475 0.0065 5.6e-114
observed 34 +0.1497 0.0066 2.3e-115
imputed 25 +0.1274 0.0073 7.6e-68
Past tobacco smoking -> lung cancer (C34.1) all 106 -0.0013 0.0005 0.015
observed 54 -0.0016 0.0007 0.028
imputed 68 -0.0022 0.0007 0.00091

What the three pairs demonstrate is replication across provenance:

  • BMI → CHD — all 592-ish instruments give the same estimate whether the instruments are restricted to observed cells or to imputed-only cells: the imputed estimates reproduce the observed ones to within their standard errors, with a real instrument panel (487 imputed-only instruments, IVW +0.0125 vs +0.0132 observed).
  • LDL proxy → CHD — the OGS-00009 report published this pair as a pipeline check: n=34, beta=+0.1497, se=0.0066. The observed-only condition here reproduces it exactly (see Cross-release fidelity) — same store content for observed cells, same numbers out — and adds 25 imputed-only instruments agreeing with it.
  • Smoking → lung cancer — reported with an explicit caveat below.
WarningTwo of these three pairs are proxies, on purpose, loudly

ukb-b contains no LDL biomarker: the “LDL” exposure is cholesterol-lowering medication (statin) use, a treatment proxy confounded by indication; its positive estimate is the confounding showing through, and it is kept as a correctness check, not presented as a causal LDL effect.

ukb-b contains no lung-cancer incidence trait: the outcome is the ICD-10 C34.1 cancer-site field, coded only among cancer cases (~1,000 cases). Conditioning on any diagnosis makes it a collider endpoint, so its negative IVW sign is a site-shift ratio among cancers, not the causal effect of smoking on lung-cancer risk.

These are shown as they are because this store can only support what its sources measured, and imputation completes coverage of the reported phenotypes — it does not create phenotypes. A scientifically better trait of interest (LDL, BMI, smoking) than the ones present here, imputation cannot make one appear.

Regional plots: every variant, coloured by provenance

Each exposure’s own strongest imputed genome-wide hit defines a 2 Mb window; every variant of the completed axis inside the window is plotted against the exposure’s significance — blue observed, orange imputed, grey the axis rows that remain NaN even after completion, drawn as ticks on the floor.

/tmp/ipykernel_3909743/1934271115.py:20: UserWarning: You passed an edgecolor/edgecolors ('#b9b9b9') for an unfilled marker ('|').  Matplotlib is ignoring the edgecolor in favor of the facecolor.  This behavior may change in the future.
  ax.scatter(pos[msk], y, s=ms * 3, c=col, marker=mk, alpha=0.75, linewidths=0.4,

In the BMI window the axis is fully covered: every one of 4,546 variants carries a cell, and imputation adds 1,032 that the source GWAS-VCFs never reported (29% of the observed count there). In the statin window, at the APOE/APOC lipid cluster, imputation adds 1,806, and the grey ticks at the floor are the 701 axis rows still NaN after completion: panel-rejected or off-panel variants that completion cannot and does not pretend to fill.

Cross-release fidelity

Reference Completion is required to add cells and never rewrite observed ones (ADR 0011). Checked directly: every cell the statin-pair instruments carry in OGS-00009 was re-read from OGS-00010 and compared after decoding.

Check Result
Pair compared LDL proxy (cholesterol-lowering medication) -> CHD (I25.1)
Cells compared (instruments x 2 Analyses) 5,026
Observed cells missing from the completed store 0
Cells whose status is not observed in the completion 0
max Δz
max Δse

Bit-identical decoding, every cell.

And the MR consequence: the observed-only condition of the statin pair on OGS-00010 returns 34 instruments, IVW +0.1497 — OGS-00009’s published 34 instruments, +0.1497. Same answers, from a store that also holds ten billion more of them.

Limitations

  • The quality metric is in-sample. Block Pearson r compares the imputation fit against the observed cells used to fit it. It gates what gets published (r ≥ 0.7) but is not a cross-validated accuracy; the MR replication and fidelity checks are the external ones available here.
  • Two proxy traits, as flagged above. The MR section is a pipeline and query-shape demonstration with real UKB phenotypes, not a causal-effects results paper; none of the three estimates should be quoted as one.
  • Warm cache. Same convention as the OGS-00009 report: medians of 5 repetitions after warm-up. A cold first query is bounded by disk.
  • One machine, one panel. A single EUR panel (eur-hg38-gpm); off-panel cells (19.7%) of the axis) stay missing by design, and non-European Analyses would impute differently or not at all.
  • Memory sampling resolution. Peak sampled at 5 ms; sub-millisecond spikes in indexed shapes can be missed (their reported costs are ~0 anyway).
